body.text: The agreement would provide apartment-style housing for National Guard troops in Washington. The central question is not whether the lodging is nicer than hotel rooms. It is why taxpayers are being asked to underwrite such a large and extended deployment in the first place.

slides.label: THE TIMELINE
slides.citation: JenniWren Studio internal Photo Story template test

timeline_entries.text: Officials announced the new three-year housing arrangement for troops stationed in Washington.
The contract keeps the lodging commitment in place as the mission continues with no clear off-ramp.
Under the current framework, the deployment could continue into the next inauguration cycle.
